name: Tayori Tanomi
source:
A second-year transfer student who came to class on the same day as [url=/c89999]Kuzumi Kiyoshirou[/url]. With her bright and bubbly personality, she easily makes friends with everyone. However, she also values her personal space and cherishes her alone time. Kuzumi and Tanomi met the day before she transferred to the school, and ever since, he has been her go-to person for anything she needs.

Though she may not excel in group settings, she finds solace in her love for exploration and adventure, often taking side trips during her free time to satisfy her insatiable curiosity. 

Going home style: Loves taking side trips.
As the school bell rings, signalling the end of the day, Tanomi sets off on her journey home with a different route in mind. Her inquisitive nature leads her to explore the nooks and crannies of the town, taking detours and uncovering new sights and sounds. Suppose Kuzumi happens to cross her path on her way home. In that case, they'll join forces and embark on a leisurely stroll, sharing their latest discoveries and having private moments together.
